_status: Policy as DATA (ADR-0014). Aliases are the ones the installed Claude Code accepts via --model ('sonnet', 'opus', 'fable'; confirm with `claude --help`). Never hard-code full model ids here; the CLI resolves the alias to the latest model of that family. 'haiku' is used only if probe_aliases confirms it.

rules.why: hardest long-horizon asynchronous work where Fable materially outperforms; not for routine implementation
complex planning, cross-lane integration, high-risk review or a bug that already beat a cheaper attempt
two failed attempts: use a stronger model, and allow Fable only if long_horizon
default bounded implementation, tests, adapters, docs, routine refactors, bounded research

efficiency.resume_only_if: private working context is genuinely valuable and still compact

quota_guard.note: Workers refuse to launch when the latest SUPPORTED quota reading (Claude Code rate_limit_event) is above these. A stale or missing reading never blocks (UNKNOWN is not a stop). --ignore-quota overrides, and the override is recorded.
